title: Numbers and Text
subtitle: Work with whole numbers, decimals, and character data.
objective: Catch the needed tokens for each Java variable statement and assemble them correctly.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid double variable declaration for price.
hints: Double is used for decimal values.
The decimal value should not be in quotation marks.
Place the value after the equals sign.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid char variable declaration for grade.
hints: A char stores one character only.
Java declarations still end with a semicolon.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid int variable declaration for lives.
hints: Use int for a whole-number value.
The variable name should come right after int.
The number 3 is written without quotation marks.
